clusters.title: I finally found a free open-source tool that can replace PowerPoint, Canva, and Claude Design for presentations

xda.author: Nolen Jonker
xda.body:
I finally found a free open-source tool that can replace PowerPoint, Canva, and Claude Design for presentations
Presentation software is one of those tools almost everyone ends up needing, whether that's for a class project or something you agreed to months ago and completely forgot about. But the catch is that the popular options usually tend to hold back their best features for paying users. PowerPoint comes bundled with Microsoft 365 and the Personal plan is now $100 a year. Canva now keeps most of its templates and AI allowance behind the Pro subscription. And even though Claude Design is available to free users now, it's heavily capped.
